outOfScope: Session checkpoint/history or generation chains for Outer Blackboard workers.
Generic loading/excerpting of every current-system or dependency-ref body into interactive context.
Changing Jev verdict semantics, CI selection, merge policy, task scheduling or the two-lane model.
Automatically claiming or selecting PLANNED work during fresh-session bootstrap.
Changing product-runtime Blackboard/session-handoff semantics inside packages/agentic-system.
constraints: RESEARCH_SA only until a fresh Jev readiness judgment accepts the exact plan; this task may not mutate implementation source in its research PR.
The envelope is a non-authority projection over canonical graph/plan/evaluation state; it may explain legal transitions but cannot create claims, judgments, merge evidence or delivery receipts.
Preserve the two-lane model, current-only context semantics, exact candidate/evaluation/merge binding and independent Jev judgment.
An unclaimed MERGE_PENDING task may be materialized only when its exact work id is supplied; bootstrap must not auto-select PLANNED work or grant source-write authority.
Do not add session-history generations, a second workflow engine, repository-wide default discovery, or generic context-body retrieval in this task.
invariants: For every OBJECTIVE_PLAN_DELIVERY context, deliveryEnvelope.workId/lane/phase/subject must match the canonical derived context; the envelope is descriptive data and never mutates graph, claim, evaluation, merge or delivery state.

Implicit bootstrap selection remains ACTIVE-only. The only non-ACTIVE explicit bootstrap exception is exactly PLANNED/WORKER/MERGE_PENDING with an explicit work id; it creates no claim and no current.json.
JUDGMENT and MERGE_PENDING always materialize sourceScope.write=[] and forbiddenWrite=['**']; their bootstrap currentGoal/rules cannot advertise implementation, repair or self-acceptance authority.
DONE/DELIVERED is never a delivery-envelope next action. Existing verifyDelivery -> publishDelivery remains the only finalization path, with exact evaluated candidate ancestry/tree checks unchanged.
architectureDecisions: D1 — `scripts/blackboard-delivery-context.mjs`: derive one `DELIVERY_ENVELOPE_V1` inside `deriveDeliveryContext` from the canonical task/plan/contract only. Use `phaseMatrix` verbatim for phase-local goal/conditions/actions, copy only already-bound subject identity, fail closed when JUDGMENT/MERGE_PENDING lacks its required identity, set `action.kind` from the phase row, and set `expectedOutputs` from `deliveryEnvelope.requiredOutputs` instead of the current WORKER-wide `DELIVERED_FEATURE` end-state.

D2 — `scripts/blackboard-context-contract.mjs`: for every `OBJECTIVE_PLAN_DELIVERY` spec require and validate `deliveryEnvelopeContract`: exact workId/lane/phase/semantic/plan identity, non-empty string arrays for entryConditions/requiredOutputs/exitConditions/nextActions/forbiddenActions, no `DONE`/`DELIVERED` next action, and read-only JUDGMENT/MERGE_PENDING. Keep the existing execution write-scope rule unchanged.

D3 — `scripts/blackboard-context-materialize.mjs`: copy `spec.deliveryEnvelope` verbatim into the common materialized context for all profiles. No resolver/history scan, no duplicated workflow state and no mutation are added.

D4 — `scripts/blackboard-implementation-bootstrap.mjs`: keep implicit selection exactly ACTIVE-only. When `itemId` is explicit, additionally allow exactly `status=PLANNED && lane=WORKER && phase=MERGE_PENDING && contract!=null`. ACTIVE tasks still verify/materialize canonical `current.json`; explicit MERGE_PENDING calls `deriveTaskContext` directly and never writes graph/current.json or claims work. Return `intent=context.deliveryEnvelope.currentGoal`, `rules=context.deliveryEnvelope.forbiddenActions`, `phase=context.deliveryEnvelope.phase`.

D5 — Exact phase semantics are the `phaseMatrix` field: RESEARCH builds a plan; EXECUTION implements; REPAIR repairs exact findings; JUDGMENT is independent read-only candidate judgment; MERGE_PENDING is read-only exact-candidate finalization. The MERGE_PENDING action order is merge exact evaluated candidate -> fetch main/exact mergeSha -> `verify:blackboard-delivery` -> `publish:blackboard-delivery`; no direct DONE transition exists.

D6 — `test/blackboard-context-delivery-onboarding.test.mjs` implements `coldStartTestContract`. Use `RICH_CODING_HARNESS` for bootstrap fixtures, assert graph bytes/claim/currentContextRef are unchanged by explicit merge resume, and bind NEG_152_1..3 to the exact existing negativeCaseBindings titles and subject symbols.

D7 — `test/blackboard-context-bootstrap.test.mjs` changes its contracted-WORKER expectation from the single `IMPLEMENT_EXACT_READY_PLAN` intent to the phase row's `currentGoal`, while preserving legacy non-contract behavior. `test/blackboard-task-context-resolver.test.mjs` adds envelope identity assertions for one runnable contracted task.

D8 — `AGENTS.md` and `docs/living/system/state.md` document only delivered semantics: fresh agents follow the phase-local envelope for the immediate obligation; the envelope is non-authority; explicit MERGE_PENDING resume is read-only; graph/plan/Jev/evidence/merge receipt remain canonical authority. No Blackboard id or research status appears in Living Docs.
implementationSlices: S1 — Delivery envelope derivation [PHASE_CONTEXT, AUTHORITY]: edit `deriveDeliveryContext` exactly per D1/D5, including the five phase rows, phase-required identity checks, phase-local `action.kind`, read-only JUDGMENT/MERGE_PENDING scope and `expectedOutputs = deliveryEnvelope.requiredOutputs`. No delivery/Jev/work-graph mutation code is touched.

S2 — Contract + materialization [PHASE_CONTEXT, AUTHORITY]: edit `assertWorkContext` to validate the exact envelope identity/array/read-only/no-direct-DONE rules from `deliveryEnvelopeContract`; edit `materializeContext` common output to expose the envelope verbatim for RICH/GENERIC/WEAK profiles.

S3 — Bootstrap + explicit finalization resume [BOOTSTRAP, MERGE_RESUME]: implement D4 exactly: implicit ACTIVE-only selection; explicit-only PLANNED/WORKER/MERGE_PENDING branch via `deriveTaskContext`; no claim/current.json writes; intent/rules/phase projected from the envelope. All other non-ACTIVE tasks fail closed.

S4 — Cold-start tests [PHASE_CONTEXT, BOOTSTRAP, MERGE_RESUME, AUTHORITY]: add the two positive tests plus NEG_152_1..3 exactly as `coldStartTestContract`; update the existing bootstrap/resolver assertions per D7. The merge-resume test snapshots graph JSON before/after the call and asserts byte-equivalent task claim/currentContextRef.

S5 — Operator truth + regression [PHASE_CONTEXT, AUTHORITY]: update AGENTS.md and `docs/living/system/state.md` per D8; run focused test, `npm run verify:blackboard-context`, and `npm run verify:current-docs`. Worker Jev and exact merge/delivery remain later independent gates.
